title: AION 2 Races: Elyos or Asmodians
description: Compare AION 2 Elyos and Asmodians: Verteron vs Altgard, campaign locations, dungeon parties, PvP opponents, classes and server transfers.
summary: Elyos and Asmodians explore different campaign territories and fight on opposing PvP sides, while dungeon parties can include both factions.
quickAnswer: Elyos follow the Verteron campaign; Asmodians follow the Altgard campaign. Both factions can join the same dungeon party across servers. Choose the same faction and home server for shared world questing; server transfers keep your faction.
